nodes.description: _rOwned mapping storing reflection balances for every account
_tOwned mapping storing token balances of excluded accounts
_allowances nested mapping holding ERC20 approval amounts
_isExcludedFromFee mapping marking fee-exempt accounts
_isExcluded mapping marking reflection-excluded accounts
_excluded array holding all reflection-excluded addresses
botWallets mapping marking addresses blacklisted from trading
botscantrade flag deciding whether blacklisted wallets may trade
canTrade flag gating public trading until owner enables it
_tTotal total token supply
_rTotal total reflection supply
_tFeeTotal accumulated token fees collected
marketingWallet address receiving ETH and marketing share
_taxFee percentage of reflection tax applied on transfers
_liquidityFee percentage routed to liquidity on transfers
immutable reference to the Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity
immutable address of the created Uniswap V2 trading pair
inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap modifier
swapAndLiquifyEnabled toggle controlling automatic swap+liquify
_maxTxAmount maximum amount transferable per transaction
threshold of contract tokens that triggers swapAndLiquify
_owner address of the current contract owner (Ownable)
_previousOwner address stored while the contract is locked
_lockTime timestamp until which owner functions are locked
_transfer internal routine: validation, max-tx check, auto swapAndLiquify and fee handling
swapAndLiquify splits contract tokens, swaps half for ETH, pays marketing share and adds liquidity
swapTokensForEth approves the router and swaps tokens for ETH via the router
addLiquidity approves the router and adds token/ETH liquidity for the owner
_tokenTransfer dispatches transfer to the correct reflection transfer variant and toggles fees
_transferStandard transfer path where neither sender nor recipient is excluded
_transferToExcluded transfer path where the recipient is excluded
_transferFromExcluded transfer path where the sender is excluded
_transferBothExcluded transfer path where both parties are excluded
_getValues computes reflection and token amounts including fee shares
_getRate derives the current reflection-to-token rate
_getCurrentSupply computes circulating reflection and token supplies excluding excluded accounts
_takeLiquidity moves the liquidity share of reflections to the contract itself
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal by the collected fee
claimTokens (onlyOwner) sends the whole ETH balance of the contract to marketingWallet
clearStuckBalance (onlyOwner) sends the contract ETH balance to an arbitrary address
claimOtherTokens (onlyOwner) withdraws arbitrary ERC20 tokens held by the contract
lock (onlyOwner) renounces ownership for a period based on block.timestamp
unlock restores the previous owner once the timestamp-based lock expires
transferOwnership (onlyOwner) transfers ownership to newOwner
airdrop (onlyOwner) fee-free transfer of scaled token amount to a recipient
airdropInternal internal fee-free transfer helper used by the airdrop routines
airdropArray (onlyOwner) loops over holders and amounts performing fee-free transfers
deliver burns reflections from the caller and increases _tFeeTotal
excludeFromReward (onlyOwner) moves an account from reflection tracking to _tOwned tracking
includeInReward (onlyOwner) removes an account from the excluded list
ERC20 transfer entrypoint forwarding to _transfer with msg.sender as sender
ERC20 transferFrom entrypoint forwarding to _transfer and updating allowance
ERC20 approve entrypoint forwarding to internal _approve
_approve internal routine writing _allowances and emitting Approval
excludeFromFee (onlyOwner) marks an account as fee exempt
includeInFee (onlyOwner) removes an account from the fee-exempt list
setMarketingWallet (onlyOwner) updates the marketing wallet address
allowtrading (onlyOwner) permanently enables public trading
addBotWallet (onlyOwner) blacklists an address from trading
removeBotWallet (onlyOwner) removes an address from the blacklist
upliftTxAmount (onlyOwner) raises the max transaction amount
setSwapThresholdAmount (onlyOwner) updates the auto-swap threshold
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled (onlyOwner) toggles automatic swap and liquify
receive fallback accepting ETH returned by the Uniswap router during swaps
msg.sender untrusted caller address used for ownership, transfers and access checks
block.timestamp miner-influenced value used for locking and swap deadlines
payable(marketingWallet).transfer(address(this).balance) ETH payout in claimTokens
walletaddress.transfer(address(this).balance) ETH payout in clearStuckBalance
tokenAddress.transfer(...) arbitrary external ERC20 call in claimOtherTokens
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens external call with block.timestamp deadline
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH value-bearing external call with block.timestamp deadline
payable(marketingWallet).transfer(marketingshare) ETH payout inside swapAndLiquify
recipient.call{value: amount} low level ETH call in Address.sendValue library helper
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) low level external call in Address._functionCallWithValue
recipient parameter of the ERC20 transfer function
amount parameter of the ERC20 transfer function
from/sender address parameter of _transfer and transferFrom
spender parameter of the approve function
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
time parameter of lock, added to block.timestamp for _lockTime
account parameter of excludeFromReward/includeInReward
tAmount parameter flowing into _getValues and the fee calculations
contractTokenBalance local in _transfer used to decide whether to swap and liquify
takeFee local flag in _transfer/_tokenTransfer controlling fee application
half local in swapAndLiquify, the token half swapped for ETH
newBalance local in swapAndLiquify holding ETH gained from the swap
marketingshare local in swapAndLiquify, computed as 80% of the new balance
path local array in swapTokensForEth describing the token to WETH route
walletaddress parameter of clearStuckBalance receiving the ETH payout
tokenAddress parameter of claimOtherTokens used for the external transfer

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a formal argument of transfer and flows directly into _transfer
amount is only a formal argument of transfer and is consumed by the internal transfer arithmetic
the from/sender parameter is a temporary alias for the sender account used by _transfer
spender is only a formal argument forwarded into the _approve allowance writer
newOwner is a formal argument written straight into the _owner state variable
time is a formal argument used only to compute _lockTime from block.timestamp
account is a formal argument pushed into the _excluded array
tAmount is a formal argument fully absorbed by the _getValues fee computation
contractTokenBalance is a short-lived local deciding the swapAndLiquify trigger inside _transfer
takeFee is a short-lived local controlling fee removal inside _tokenTransfer
half is a short-lived local computed as contractTokenBalance.div(2) inside swapAndLiquify
newBalance is a short-lived local holding the ETH gained during the swap
marketingshare is the exact value passed to the marketing wallet ETH transfer
path is a short-lived memory array passed to the router swap call
walletaddress is a formal argument that directly receives the contract ETH balance
tokenAddress is a formal argument used as the external token contract in the transfer call
